# Form Items: Get a Form Item

Area overview and notes: [form-items.md](../form-items.md)

`GET /users/{userId}/form-items/{formItemId}` · tenant-scoped token

Get a form item by id.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `userId` | Your system's unique identifier for the Account (User) that owns the form item. |
| `formItemId` | Your system's unique identifier for the form item. |

**Response 200**: Form item with the provided ID.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `form_item` | one of several shapes | No |  |
| `form_item.id` | string (unique id) | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the form item. |
| `form_item.user_id` | string (unique id) | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the Account (User) |

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request · 404 Not Found · 429 Too Many Requests
